diagnosis.internal_check_finding: [WinError 2] system cannot find the specified file
diagnosis.root_cause: The frozen gate invokes subprocess.run with the bare executable name openspec. Windows PowerShell resolves the npm wrapper, but shell-free CreateProcess cannot launch the .CMD wrapper by the bare name. Existing gate tests contain no OpenSpec process-launch coverage.

recovery_boundary.required: Return to Change A, add a Windows npm-wrapper regression test and the minimum cross-platform launcher fix, rerun all G1 evidence, obtain renewed human tool approval, and explicitly re-freeze the new tool digest before resuming G8.
recovery_boundary.not_authorized_yet: The current plan does not define how a post-G2 tool revision is rebound to the existing content-frozen baseline, so no frozen tool, manifest, baseline, policy or state file may be changed without a narrow human-approved recovery protocol.
